result.title: Printable book of some rationalist creative writing (from Scott A. & Eliezer)

contents.markdown:
As a holiday gift to myself, I put together a printable book of some creative writing by Scott Alexander & Eliezer. I'm sharing it here in case anyone else is interested :).

It contains most of Scott's published fiction since he switched to Substack, plus some select creative non-fiction pieces (including a few from the old SSC days). I tried to choose writings that did not overlap with the [other printable book of his older fiction pieces](https://www.lulu.com/shop/scott-alexander/the-goddess-of-everything-else/paperback/product-j6d7wv.html?page=1&pageSize=4). The collection also has a few stories by Eliezer that I love and haven't seen in print elsewhere.

The PDF can be found here: [https://thatadammorris.com/files/bread-crumbs.pdf](https://thatadammorris.com/files/bread-crumbs.pdf). You can print is using Blurb's [PDF to book functionality](https://www.blurb.com/pdf-to-book). Instructions:

1.  Click on "Upload PDF".
2.  Select "Cover & Pages in Single File".
3.  Upload the PDF.
4.  Select "Trade Book" (or keep it as photo book if you want to pay more for nicer print paper), and set the spine color to black. I chose softcover with standard pages. Select "Upload to Blurb".
5.  It will say there are problems with the PDF -- just hit "Attempt to Correct & Continue".
6.  Ignore the issues it raises (they're all not a problem) and hit "Preview My Book".
7.  From there, you can order the book!

Obviously all credit for the writing goes to Scott & Eliezer. (Cover image generated by GPT 4o.)
